title: Rod's Ultimate Vanilla Experience
description: This pack includes everything from performance mods to sound improvements and controller support
body:
**Ultimate Vanilla Experience ModPack combines the performance mods seen on the front pages and QoL from all over Modrinth.**
## This pack changes/adds:
1. Your FPS (frames per second), it boosts performance 📈
2. Sounds, villagers have 40+ new sounds. ambience has changed, walking sounds etc. are improved 🔊
3. Textures, an Improved Font! 🔤🪄
4. Controller support (Controlify) 🎮
5. Adds the Essential Mod (mod that allows to change skins in-game, add friends, etc.) 📥
6. Mod APIs (Fabric, Factory, Forge Config) 🛠️
7. HUD upgrades, UI instances now open smoothly. F3 menu is enhanced, chat now shows player heads 👁️
8. 3D skin rendering, your skin's outer layer will now render as a 3D object❗


** I DO NOT OWN ANY CONTENT MENTIONED HERE, I AM SIMPLY COMBINING THEM INTO ONE MODPACK FOR FUTURE EASE OF USE TO OTHER PEOPLE **
